subject: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

Team —

We have a verbal acceptance from Alex Romero (external) for the L5 Senior Software Engineer role on infra team. Recruiter sent over the proposed package; attaching the current comp band and my draft offer for review. High-level ask: sign-off on base / bonus / equity so we can send the formal offer by EOD Monday.

Proposed package (total comp rationale in attachment):
- Base: $195,000
- Target bonus: 15% annual
- Equity: 9,000 RSUs over 4 years (25/25/25/25 vest) with 1 year cliff
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time) to offset counteroffer + relocation stipend (US-based move)

Notes: candidate has 7 years experience, exiting a startup with a buyout; market comps in SF/NY pushed base higher — I calibrated to midpoint+ for retention. Laura, hiring manager asked for slightly higher equity to secure them. Marissa — please confirm comp-band fit and whether sign-on needs extra approval.

Attachments: L5-comp-band.pdf, offer-draft-alex-romero.docx

Thanks,
Marcus
Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

Marcus,

Thanks — quick clarifying questions before I route to comp sign-off:
- Is the proposed base ($195k) within the published L5 band for region (SF)? Attachment suggests midpoint ~185k.
- How was the 9,000 RSU figure derived vs. standard 6,000 for L5? Is this an uplift for retention / counteroffer?
- Sign-on of $25k: is that cash-only or split (cash + additional RSUs)? We try to prefer cash for early retention events.

If Marissa confirms band exception rationale, I can approve an exception up to $25k sign-on and +25% equity uplift, but anything above that needs Markus' explicit sign-off. Laura — please confirm that the hiring urgency justifies the uplift vs. backfilling quickly with internal candidates.

— Soojin
Director, Talent Acq.
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

On Sat, May 15, 2027 at 10:04 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus,
>
> Thanks — quick clarifying questions before I route to comp sign-off:
> - Is the proposed base ($195k) within the published L5 band for region (SF)? Attachment suggests midpoint ~185k.
> - How was the 9,000 RSU figure derived vs. standard 6,000 for L5? Is this an uplift for retention / counteroffer?
> - Sign-on of $25k: is that cash-only or split (cash + additional RSUs)? We try to prefer cash for early retention events.

Thanks for the call yesterday. Short answers:
- Base: $195k is slightly above published L5 midpoint for SF (band shows 170–205k); we're at upper quartile but within band top.
- Equity: Hiring manager requested uplift for two reasons — (1) candidate has prior RSU cliff that ends in 9 months, so to offset deferral risk we recommended 50% uplift (6k -> 9k), (2) candidate has strong infra experience that is high value for the roadmap.
- Sign-on: cash-only $25k (no RSU split). We recommended cash because Alex prefers immediate liquidity to cover relocation and to neutralize counteroffers.

Laura confirmed urgency: product roadmap dependency and candidate's notice period means we risk losing them if not competitive.

If Marissa says band exception is OK, Marcus asks for Soojin/Markus sign-off.

— Marcus
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

Thanks for the context. A couple of operational checks before full approval:
1) Total comp and equity uplift look reasonable given the market and urgency, but I want to ensure we track this as a one-off band exception tied to this hire (HIRE-1423).
2) Approve $25k cash sign-on contingent on a 12-month clawback if they voluntarily leave within 12 months (standard).
3) Approve equity at 9k RSUs, but mark 15% of the grant as retention RSUs with a 2-year accelerated tranche to handle acquisition/retention risk.

If Marissa confirms no policy blockers, you have my sign-off and I’ll let legal finalize clawback language.

-Markus
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

Hi all — reviewed the proposed package and attachments. Summary:
- Base $195,000: within L5 band top quartile for SF region (acceptable).
- Bonus 15%: within target range.
- Equity 9,000 RSUs: requires comp exception form but allowable; recommend adding a short note in the HR file describing the candidate-specific rationale (counteroffer + critical skill set).
- Sign-on $25,000 cash: acceptable; please apply standard 12-month clawback (policy HR-CO-04).

I uploaded the completed comp-exception form to the candidate folder and attached an annotated comp-band PDF with highlighted ranges for L4/L5. No further approvals needed beyond Markus' sign-off which has been provided.

Attachments: L5-comp-band.pdf (annotated)

— Marissa
Head of Compensation & Benefits
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Greenfield Talent <recruiter@greenfield.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Salary & Equity Alignment for Senior Software Engineer (L5)

All — thanks for the quick reviews and for uploading the comp-exception form. Given Marissa's validation and Markus' conditional sign-off, I approve sending the formal offer with the following confirmed terms:
- Base: $195,000
- Bonus: 15% target
- Equity: 9,000 RSUs (standard vesting schedule; 15% flagged as retention tranche)
- Sign-on: $25,000 cash with 12-month clawback

Marcus — please have Legal draft the final offer language including the clawback and retention tranche specifics, and copy me once the DocuSign is ready. Recruiter — send candidate a courtesy heads-up that the offer will hit Monday morning.

— Soojin
Director, Talent Acq.
